name: bench_roles
description: A dataset of role-labeled conversational examples intended to evaluate a model's ability to adopt and maintain different conversational roles. It contains prompts and expected role-consistent responses to measure both role-identification and role-appropriate generation. The benchmark is useful for testing role-following, persona consistency, and role-conditioned response quality.
reputation: A small community dataset on HuggingFace for role-based conversational evaluation with limited adoption.
